summary: Verified all three fixes for iteration 75: (1) POST /api/mcgs/george/speak now returns HTTP 200 audio/mpeg with george, georgia and default voices — the module-level GeorgeSpeakIn Pydantic model is correctly resolved as a body model (regression test confirms missing-body 422 has body-level `loc`, not the old query.body bug). (2) The frontend SpeakerButton in the George Event Creation screen fires POST /speak on tap and the request returns 200 audio/mpeg cleanly, with no console errors and no silent no-op. (3) The Mission Control entry point renders at the top of /admin for admin `maggie` with testID='admin-mission-control-link', a BETA badge, and the correct subtitle; tapping it opens `${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/admin/bridge` in a new tab (WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync). The button is correctly hidden for non-admin members (member@friendplace.com.au sees the 'Admin tools are only available to FriendPlace moderators' lockout).
critical_code_review_comments: mcgs_module.py is now ~1425 lines and well over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into per-domain sub-routers (rhythms, george, cases/signals, actions) to keep it maintainable.
george-api.ts speak() writes to Paths.cache with a hash-named file but never prunes stale files — over time the cache directory could accumulate MP3s. A soft cap or LRU eviction would be safer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Mission Control button + speaker button + non-admin lockout all verified

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded accounts (maggie admin demo, member@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026!).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter75 covers the George TTS /speak fix (model moved to module level) and the mobile Mission Control entry point on the /admin screen. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter75_george_speak.py. To test the SpeakerButton via web preview: login as member (member@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026!), tap the small teal butterfly at approx (346, 132) on the /home screen to open George Event Creation, then tap the volume-medium icon inside George's greeting bubble (approx x=82, y=711 in 390x844 viewport). Watch the network for POST /api/mcgs/george/speak → 200 audio/mpeg. To reach /admin as maggie: demo-login via login-toggle-demos + demo-maggie testIDs, then window.history.pushState({}, '', '/admin') + popstate to navigate (Expo Router handles it). The button has testID='admin-mission-control-link' and opens a popup to /admin/bridge on web.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this iteration verified pre-applied fixes. Prior RCA (documented in problem statement): GeorgeSpeakIn was defined as a nested class inside build_router(), which FastAPI could not introspect as a body model, so every /speak request 422'd with loc=['query','body']. Fix: hoist the model to module level. Frontend regression: SpeakerButton silently swallowed the 422, giving the 'button does nothing' symptom — now surfaces failures via useToast().show().
